Bergamot Translator browser runtime
https://github.com/browsermt/bergamot-translator
npm package @browsermt/bergamot-translator, version 0.4.9
License: Mozilla Public License 2.0

Spanish-to-English Firefox Translations model
https://github.com/mozilla/translations
Model artifacts published by Mozilla for Firefox Translations.
License: Mozilla Public License 2.0

The unmodified runtime and model artifacts are kept in this directory so
Library search can expand short Spanish descriptions locally. Search text and
model inference remain on the user's machine.
